narrow: cis assembly of U12-type pre-catalytic spliceosome
cis assembly of U2-type pre-catalytic spliceosome

definition: Assembly of a spliceosomal complex containing the intact pre-mRNA and all of the spliceosomal snRNPs. This occurs when the tri-snRNP associates with the pre-mRNA and associated snRNPs in an ATP-dependent manner.
label: cis assembly of pre-catalytic spliceosome
